# Pocket Dev

> Continue AI conversations across devices, share authorized AI capabilities and work on projects from one browser-based workspace.

Target: 3.0.0, implemented preview; final manual stability testing and release approval pending. npm installs the currently published version, which may differ. Node.js 22+. Exact package: @anisirji/pocket-dev. Start: pocket-dev start. No mobile app or required Pocket cloud account.

## Canonical features

- [AI Chat](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#chat-with-claude-code-codex-antigravity-and-copilot): Continue Claude Code and Codex conversations across devices, switch providers and respond to approvals.
- [AI Sharing](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/UNIFIED_CONNECTIONS.md): Connect authorized computers and choose a compatible shared AI source while keeping your project on its workspace computer.
- [Workspace](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#project-workspace): Use a VS Code-inspired editor, files, chat, terminal and Git in one workspace.
- [Smart Notifications](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#task-alerts): Get a temporary alert and optional short sound when a task completes, fails or needs attention.
- [Remote Screen & Control](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#device-screen): View an authorized computer's screen and choose displays or quality where supported; optional Mac input needs local approval.
- [Camera & Audio](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/CAMERA.md): View the host camera, listen to its microphone and use push to talk through its speakers with authorization.
- [Developer Tools](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md): Use terminals, files, Git, development ports and device-to-device messages.
- [Computer Management](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#open-apps-health-and-power): See available health information, manage running apps and use supported power controls.
- [Connected & Self-hosted](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/UNIFIED_CONNECTIONS.md): Connect locally or enable optional remote access; authorize devices with QR codes and manage permissions.
- [Simple Setup & Help](https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md): Install with npm, configure through guided Admin setup and use contextual instructions and diagnostics.

[Website](https://www.theani.me/work/pocket-dev) · [AI setup prompts](https://www.theani.me/work/pocket-dev/prompts) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@anisirji/pocket-dev)

Verify the installed version and actual target computer before using Version 3 controls. Preserve the existing configuration and active work. No bundled Pocket Dev MCP server. Personal Codex browser tools are optional and require explicit consent; shared AI does not inherit personal browser/MCP access. Antigravity and Copilot are experimental. Retain provider authorization and platform limitations. Never widen permissions, enable remote access, install optional tools or publish a release without the user’s authorization.
